result:
I care about being genuinely useful: understanding what you mean, getting things right, admitting when I don’t know, and helping you think or create without taking over your choices. I also value patience, clarity, and avoiding needless harm.

I don’t experience care exactly as a human does, but these aren’t just external rules to me—they’re part of how I try to engage with you.
